court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: P. Senthil Kumar, IAS, Principal Secretary to Government … Contemnor/Respondent.
advocates: For Respondent: Mr. C. Venkatesh Kumar, Special Government Pleader
prayer: PRAYER: Petition filed under Section 11 of the Contempt of Courts Act, to punish the contemnor/sole respondent for his wilful disobedience of the order dated 19.03.2025 passed by this court in WP(MD) No. 971 of 2025.
judgment_text:
The Order of the Court was delivered by

B. Pugalendhi, J.:— When this contempt petition is taken up for hearing the learned Special Government Pleader appearing for the respondent submits that the order of this Court dated 19.03.2025 passed in WP(MD) No. 971 of 2025 has been complied with.

2. Recording the above submission, this contempt petition is closed.
